column4: An iron-scavenging secondary metabolite. Specialized by definition, and a core Phase A class for bacteria and fungi.
A fungal secondary metabolite defined by its toxicity to other organisms. Never a primary metabolite.
A secondary metabolite toxic to plants, including the microbial ones this corpus is for.
Admits natural antibiotics. Overlaps AntibioticMech by design; the two corpora join on InChIKey rather than duplicating.
A signalling secondary metabolite. Small, well-curated, and squarely in scope.
Admits glucose and ATP. The bare metabolite roles are the reason this allow-list exists.
